अरे बाप रे! साउथ सिनेमा से आ गई है एकदम मसालेदार खबर, सुनकर फैंस का पारा हाई हो गया है 🔥

आइए जानते हैं क्या है माजरा:
• खबर है कि अजित कुमार की आने वाली action entertainer film में शिव राजकुमार नजर आ सकते हैं।
• रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, फिल्म में शिव राजकुमार को main antagonist यानी खलनायक की भूमिका के लिए देखा जा सकता है।
• हालांकि इसको लेकर अभी तक मेकर्स की तरफ से कोई पक्का ऐलान नहीं हुआ है।

क्या आप इस खतरनाक भिड़ंत को पर्दे पर देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट करके अपना जवाब जरूर बताएं! 👇✨

ctx.title: Dare Devil: Ajith Kumar’s action entertainer to feature Shiva Rajkumar as main antagonist? Here’s what we know
ctx.summary:
Dare Devil, starring Ajith Kumar in the lead role, is an upcoming action entertainer directed by Adhik Ravichandran. With reports suggesting that the film began shooting this week, Kannada superstar Shiva Rajkumar is expected to play the primary antagonist in the action drama. 
 Dare Devil: Ajith Kumar’s action film to feature Shiva Rajkumar? 
 According to The Times of India, Ajith Kumar's manager, Suresh Chandraa, has confirmed that  Shiva Rajkumar  will play the main antagonist in the film. Speaking about the casting, he said, “There is a very powerful antagonist role in the film for which we were discussing many names. Ajith sir has great respect for Shiva Rajkumar sir, and we decided to approach him.” 
 The manager further added, “Three to four months back, Adhik went and narrated the script to Shivanna, who immediately responded positively. Then, Ajith sir himself spoke to him. He will be joining the shoot by November 17 or 18.” 
 The film was officially launched with a traditional pooja ceremony. With Sreeleela and Unni Mukundan confirmed to play key roles, the project will feature music composed by Anirudh Ravichander. 
 Earlier, director Adhik Ravichandran confirmed that  Dare Devil  would mark his reunion with Ajith Kumar. The upcoming project is expected to be a family entertainer and, unlike Good Bad Ugly, is reportedly being developed to appeal to a wider audience.
